Hero Control overlay bootstrap reference

TrollSpeed by Lessica (MIT)
https://github.com/Lessica/TrollSpeed
Reference revision: a609be260c8261ead36509c3bc4ded8479da9c40

Adapted plugin application startup, accessibility window hosting,
AX HID representation and orientation/lock-state API declarations from
sources/HUDApp.mm, HUDMainApplicationDelegate.mm, HUDMainWindow.mm,
HUDRootViewController.mm and the corresponding private API headers.
The canvas, controls, profile synchronization and command bridge are
Hero Control implementations; no KIF event injection code is included.
The MIT notice is bundled in the TIPA under ThirdParty.

Runtime payload provenance (0.10.0)
The two IFix patch payloads and complaint monitor originate from the project
owner's supplied data menu new/analysis_heroskin/modified reference material.
Runtime/Payload/manifest.json records source and shipped SHA-256 digests.
The complaint Lua was adapted to retain baseline server history and versioned
23. VM bodies, field/native mappings and hook entries are preserved.
No new license grant is asserted for the owner-supplied payloads.
